title: Evaluation into the bidual detects torsion freeness for finite modules
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative integral domain and let $T$ be a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Put $T^*=\operatorname{Hom}_R(T,R)$ and $T^{**}=\operatorname{Hom}_R(T^*,R)$. The evaluation map $\eta_T:T\to T^{**}$ is defined by $\eta_T(t)(\varphi)=\varphi(t)$. Then $\eta_T$ is injective if and only if $T$ is torsion free, meaning that $at=0$ with $0\ne a\in R$ implies $t=0$.

source.place: Tag 0AV0 (more-algebra-lemma-reflexive-torsion-free), clause (3), more-algebra.tex:5162-5214; used in the proof of Tag 0EB8 and hence in the reverse implication of Tag 0AV2.

proof.text: Assume $\eta_T$ is injective. If $0\ne a\in R$ and $at=0$, then for every $\varphi\in T^*$, $a\varphi(t)=\varphi(at)=0$. Since $R$ is a domain, $\varphi(t)=0$. Thus $\eta_T(t)$ is the zero functional, namely $\eta_T(0)$; injectivity gives $t=0$. This proves torsion freeness directly, without any finiteness assumption.

source.place: Tag 0AV0 (more-algebra-lemma-reflexive-torsion-free), clause (3), proof; coordinate embedding supplied by Tag 0AUU (more-algebra-lemma-finite-torsion-free-submodule-free).

proof.text: Conversely, suppose $T$ is torsion free. Apply [lem-per-finite-torsion-free-free-embedding] with $M=T$: $R$ is a commutative integral domain and $T$ is finitely generated by hypothesis. Obtain $r\geq0$ and an injective $R$-linear map $i:T\to R^r$.

source.place: Tag 0AV0 (more-algebra-lemma-reflexive-torsion-free), clause (3), proof; coordinate embedding supplied by Tag 0AUU (more-algebra-lemma-finite-torsion-free-submodule-free).

proof.text: For each $1\leq k\leq r$, let $\pi_k:R^r\to R$ be the coordinate projection and put $\varphi_k=\pi_k\circ i\in T^*$. If $\eta_T(t)=\eta_T(u)$, evaluation on $\varphi_k$ gives $\pi_k(i(t))=\varphi_k(t)=\varphi_k(u)=\pi_k(i(u))$ for every $k$. Equality of all coordinates gives $i(t)=i(u)$, hence $t=u$ by injectivity of $i$. When $r=0$, the same equality is the unique equality in $R^0=0$ and the argument still applies. This proves injectivity of $\eta_T$ and completes the equivalence.

source.place: Tag 0AV0 (more-algebra-lemma-reflexive-torsion-free), clause (3), proof; coordinate embedding supplied by Tag 0AUU (more-algebra-lemma-finite-torsion-free-submodule-free).
